evidence_rows.evidence: Acute postoperative diabetic randomized active-tear comparison

treatments.insulin: 0.5 units topical insulin, four times daily
treatments.control: Vismed sodium hyaluronate0.18%, four times daily

evidence_rows.limit: Primary abstract does not establish the complete formulation/drop volume; no conversion to1IU/mL is inferred.

evidence_rows.evidence: Comparative PED historical-control design and exact products
evidence_rows.selection: Incomplete follow-up or absent slit-lamp images excluded; controls retrospective historical selection. Insulin patients previously receiving serum were not counted in control group.

treatments.insulin: 1IU/mL Actarapid-derived insulin in polyethylene-glycol/polypropylene-glycol base (source wording), every6hours
treatments.shared_background: Preservative-free0.15% hyaluronic-acid tears; other clinical treatments recorded

evidence_rows.storage: Insulin amber glass bottles refrigerated, source-described use up to one month
evidence_rows.limit: Not randomization; baseline p>0.05 does not establish exchangeability. No compounding recipe reproduced.

evidence_rows.evidence: Comparative PED outcomes and unequal follow-up
evidence_rows.limit: Crude recurrence contrast cannot establish causal durability advantage when observation periods and historical treatment selection differ. Healer-only closure times are conditional outcomes.

evidence_rows.product: Regular Actrapid-derived insulin in balanced salt solution,1IU/mL,four times daily
evidence_rows.prior_treatment: At least two weeks of conventional therapy
evidence_rows.handling_of_early_nonresponse: Deterioration or no significant wound-size reduction after five treatment days led to withdrawal and other intervention, retained as nonresponders in reported totals.
evidence_rows.limit: Uncontrolled population; no uniform long-term recurrence or patient-level causal effect inferred.

evidence_rows.evidence: July2026 retrospective PED cohort and closure
evidence_rows.eligibility: PED after at least two weeks first-line care; active infection and anticipated corneal procedures excluded
evidence_rows.product: Humalog-derived1IU/mL insulin in PEG/propylene-glycol/hydroxypropyl-guar vehicle,QID; refrigerated source-described30day shelf life
evidence_rows.missingness: The sole nonclosing eye had no complete closure at90days and was then lost to follow-up.
evidence_rows.limit: Retrospective uncontrolled complete-data analysis; eyes not interchangeable with independent patient count; no causal treatment magnitude.

evidence_rows.evidence: July2026 postclosure course and functional limits
evidence_rows.background_care: Tear substitutes, nocturnal ointments and indicated disease-specific support maintained

recurrence.severe_course: One recurrence progressed to melting and Gundersen flap surgery

evidence_rows.limit: Uncontrolled functional observations; finite course plus subsequent observation does not establish autonomous permanent repair. No structural reinnervation claim.

evidence_rows.product: 1IU/mL topical insulin,four times daily; complete formulation not available in abstract
evidence_rows.safety: One transient significant IOP increase reported
evidence_rows.limit: Treatment-success definition not recovered; do not equate all57eyes or all NK successes to PED closure; etiologic selection and co-treatments incompletely recovered.

evidence_rows.evidence: August2026 retrospective sensory signal, abstract only

units.independent_eye_denominator: Not explicitly recovered beyond patient count

reported_1month_results.sensitivity: Cochet–Bonnet improvement reported across all quadrants; numeric magnitude unavailable

evidence_rows.limit: No randomized control; abstract nominal one-month treatment versus mean45.6days not harmonized by assumption. No inferred18/24complete response, no structural reinnervation, no complete recurrence or co-treatment reconstruction.

evidence_rows.evidence: Planned randomized PED trial and practical product
evidence_rows.design: Multicentre randomized observer-blinded protocol; participants and treating specialists unblinded

treatments.background: Indicated tears/antibiotics continue; combination allowed after inadequate response

evidence_rows.handling: Hospital pharmacy, cold-chain distribution, refrigerated storage, seven-day discard after opening
evidence_rows.endpoints: Complete epithelialization, rate and time to closure; not new patient results
evidence_rows.limit: Planned234 is not completed enrollment; the protocol anticipated December2025 recruitment completion but this is not verified completion. No new protocol designed by this audit.
Protocol, planned enrollment and secondary-index recruitment status do not establish clinical outcomes or current verified accrual.
Primary abstract-level analytical/physical/microbiological findings; no universal insulin or mIGF stability inference and no new test executed.

evidence_rows.reported_stable_duration: one month in both tested conditions
evidence_rows.limit: Different presentation from1IU/mL PED studies. Concentration/content/sterility results do not establish every product or clinical-potency guarantee.

evidence_rows.evidence: Approved NK comparator and controlled epithelial outcomes
evidence_rows.endpoint: Absence of lesion staining and no persistent staining elsewhere in cornea
evidence_rows.missing_data_rule: Patients without any postbaseline measurement excluded
evidence_rows.sensation: Label states mean changes were not clinically significant
evidence_rows.handling: Cold storage, delivery kit and daily opened-vial limit
evidence_rows.limit: NK indication and exact product; not proof of mIGF comparison, universal sensory restoration, price or financial ownership.
Known study-start disclosure, not new efficacy or current accrual confirmation. RM4404 source pass remains closed.

evidence_rows.limit: No quote, material access, license, patient-level raw-data reanalysis or numerical financial model.
